The company offers its products under the Castrol Activ, Castrol POWER1, Castrol GTX, Castrol MAGNATEC, Castrol EDGE, Castrol CRB, Castrol VECTON, TURBOMAX, Castrol TRANSMAX, and Castrol GO! brands.

CLEANMAX.NS.d: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited develops and maintains renewable energy projects, including solar and wind, for commercial and industrial customers through Renewable Energy Power Sales and Renewable Energy Services segments. Its assets include wind and solar farms, rooftop and ground-mounted solar and solar carports. It provides turnkey engineering, procurement and construction, plus operation and maintenance, and clients can buy green power via long-term agreements.

DBL.NS.d: Dilip Buildcon Limited, together its subsidiaries, engages in the development of infrastructure facilities on engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) basis in India. It operates in two segments, EPC Projects and Toll Operations.

DHATRE.NS.d: Dhatre Udyog Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker DHATRE and traded in INR. Its country is India.

EMAMILTD.NS.d: Emami Limited manufactures and markets personal and healthcare products in India and internationally. It provides Boroplus Antiseptic Cream, Prickly Heat Powder, Doodh kesar body lotion, Zero Oil Zero Pimple Face Wash, Perfect Touch Cream, and Healthy White Fairness Cream; Navratna Cool Oil, Extra Thanda Oil, Garam Ayurvedic Oil, Almond Cool Oil, Cool Talc, and Smart Cool Talc; Zandu Balm and Ultra Power Balm; and Fair and Handsome fairness cream for men, Instant Fairness Face Wash, and Complete Winter Solution.

EMMBI.NS.d: Emmbi Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing, trading, and selling of woven polymer based products in India. It operates through four segments: Specialty Packaging, Advance Composites, Water Conservation, and Agro Polymers.

FABTECH.NS.d: Fabtech Technologies Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker FABTECH and traded in INR. Its country is India.

INNOVANA.NS.d: Innovana Thinklabs Ltd., based in Jaipur, India, develops software and mobile applications and operates in the United States, Germany, Singapore, Romania and India. Its products include astrology and tarot platforms such as Anytime Astro, Tarot Life and mPanchang.

JAICORPLTD.NS.d: Jai Corp Limited primarily engages in the plastic processing business in India. The company operates through five segments: Steel, Plastic Processing, Spinning, Assets Management activity, and Real Estate.

KALYANI.NS.d: Kalyani Commercials Limited, established in 1985 and headquartered in Delhi, works in two areas: selling and servicing commercial vehicles and two-wheelers, and retailing petroleum products such as oils, lubricants, diesel and petrol.

KHFM.NS.d: KHFM Hospitality & Facility Management Services Ltd. is an India-based company specializing in integrated facility management, hospitality management, and human resource solutions. The company provides a broad range of services including housekeeping, pest control, security, gardening, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, solid waste management, and various cleaning services. Its hospitality offerings encompass industrial and corporate catering, and guest house management.

KUANTUM.NS.d: Kuantum Papers Limited produces, markets, and sells wood free writing and printing paper in India. It offers maplitho, colored paper, ledger, cartridge, parchment, duplicating, and wood free specialty papers. The company's products are used for printing books, trade directories, newsprint, diaries, calendars, and computer stationery, as well as for manufacturing note books and other stationery items. It also exports its products.

LASERPOWER.NS.d: Laser Power & Infra Ltd. manufactures power cables, conductors and other specialised products and components for India's power transmission and distribution industry. It has two segments. Manufacturing covers conductors, specialty products and cables for power and control, while EPC delivers turnkey projects.

LLOYDS.NS.d: Luxury retail and grooming service provider holding exclusive master franchise rights for Truefitt & Hill (high-end male grooming services and luxury products) and Mary Cohr (French women's skincare and beauty treatments). Operates through franchised and company-owned stores targeting upscale clientele across India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Vietnam, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. Revenue generated from both services and retail of luxury personal care products.

MAGSON.NS.d: Magson Retail & Distribution Ltd. is engaged in the retail and distribution of gourmet, specialty, and frozen food products. The company operates a chain of retail stores under its flagship brand "MagSon", and also through specific brands like "Goan Bakery," "Nastabazar," and "My Chocolate World" for chocolates.

MAHLIFE.NS.d: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate development company in India. It operates through Projects, Project Management & Development; and Operating of Commercial Complexes segments. The Projects, Project Management & Development segment sells residential units. The Operating of Commercial Complexes segment rents commercial properties.

MANBA.NS.d: Manba Finance Ltd., founded in 1996 and based in Mumbai, is an India-based non-banking financial company. It lends for new and electric two- and three-wheelers and for used two-wheelers and cars, and also offers personal loans and funding for small businesses.

MRPL.NS.d: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited manufactures and sells refined petroleum products in India. The company produces and sells hydrogen, liquefied petroleum gas, fuel gas, motor spirit, xylol, naphtha, SKO, high speed diesel, aviation turbine fuel, furnace oil, asphalt, CRMB, LSWR, sulphur, and pet coke, as well as bitumen, polypropylene, and other products. It operates 7 retail outlets. The company serves mining, construction, power, agriculture, fertilizer, and paint industries.

NCC.NS.d: Operating both within India and internationally, NCC Limited is a prominent construction company offering a diverse range of services. The firm specializes in erecting a variety of structures, from industrial and commercial buildings, housing developments, IT parks, and shopping malls, to sports complexes, hospitals, and major stadia. Its infrastructure projects encompass the construction of roads, highways, flyovers, and bridges.

PANORAMA.NS.d: Panorama Studios International Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker PANORAMA and traded in INR. Its country is India.

PRANAV.NS.d: Pranav Constructions Ltd. redevelops existing residential buildings, especially housing societies, in Mumbai. It was formed on July 31, 2003, and has its headquarters in the same city.

RANEHOLDIN.NS.d: Rane Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets automotive components for the transportation industry in India and internationally.

RAYMONDREL.NS.d: Raymond Realty Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RAYMONDREL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

REDTAPE.NS.d: Redtape Limited, set up in 1996, with its head office in Noida, makes and distributes footwear and apparel for men, women and children in India and internationally. Its range includes casual footwear (flip-flops, sliders, slippers and sandals) as well as more structured shoes.

SAB.NS.d: SAB Industries Limited manufactures and sells textile products, including cotton yarn, fabrics, and garments. The company also trades in various commodities. SAB Industries is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

SBILIFE.NS.d: SBI Life Insurance Company Limited operates as a private life insurance company in India. Its life insurance business comprises of individual life and group business, including participating, non-participating, pension, group gratuity, group leave encashment, group superannuation, group immediate annuity, unit-linked and variable insurance products, health, and micro insurance. The company also provides accident and disability benefit, level term, and critical illness insurance products.

SCHNEIDER.NS.d: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Limited engages in designing, manufacturing, building, and servicing products and systems for electricity distribution in India and internationally. The company offers distribution, medium power, and special transformers; and substation automation systems, including power management systems, controllers and RTUs, communication elements, graphic user interfaces, engineering tools, SCADA and EMS gateways, and simulation tools.

SHERVANI.NS.d: Shervani Industrial Syndicate Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SHERVANI and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SILVERTUC.NS.d: Silver Touch Technologies Limited provides IT solutions in India and internationally. It offers enterprise software services such as digital engineering, cloud and mobile application development and DevOps, ERP solutions, and digital transformation solutions covering AI, analytics, blockchain, IoT and robotic process automation.

SMLMAH.NS.d: SML Mahindra Limited manufactures and distributes commercial vehicles and their components in India and internationally. Its range includes trucks, buses and specialised vehicles for cargo, passenger transport and particular applications.

SRIRAM-SM.NS.d: SHRI RAM SWITCHGEA appears to be involved in the manufacturing or trading of electrical switchgear products in India; details regarding its specific business model, range of products/services, and headquarter location are limited; further information is needed to provide a comprehensive description.

STEAMHOUSE.NS.d: Steamhouse India Limited builds, owns and runs centralized steam generation plants and delivers industrial steam to customers through pipelines. Beyond steam, it handles nitrogen compression, waste-to-steam solutions, utility plant operation and engineering and construction work. It designs boilers, water treatment, pollution control equipment and SCADA monitoring for pharmaceutical, chemical and other industrial clients.

SUVIDHAA.NS.d: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited offers payment services. The company provides its payment services for domestic remittance, individual and business loans, mutual fund and other investment products, ATM, utility bill payments, recharges, travel ticketing, general and life insurance, E-Commerce, bank account opening, pre-paid/gift card issuance, and cash collection and bank account deposit services through S-Commerce Platform.

TVSHLTD.NS.d: TVS Holdings Limited, originally incorporated as Sundaram-Clayton Limited, is an Indian company founded in 1962 and headquartered in Chennai. It produces automotive vehicles and components, spare parts and accessories, and provides housing development and finance services, with exports to areas such as Europe and North America.

UNIPARTS.NS.d: Uniparts India Limited and its subsidiaries make and distribute engineering systems, sub-assemblies and components worldwide, mainly for the off-highway vehicle sector. Its markets include India, the Americas, Europe, Japan and Asia Pacific, and its products include 3-point linkage parts.

VARMORA.NS.d: Varmora Granito Limited manufactures tiles, bathware, sanitaryware and adhesives, with products spanning stone, tiles, bathware and tile adhesive. Raman Varmora founded the company in 1994, and it is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

VSTIND.NS.d: VST Industries Limited manufactures and sells tobacco and its related products in India and internationally. It also offers leaf and unmanufactured tobacco, and cigarettes that contain tobacco. The company was formerly known as Vazir Sultan Tobacco Company Limited and changed its name to VST Industries Limited in April 1983. VST Industries Limited was incorporated in 1930 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
